wiki.title: Mike Bare
wiki.extract: Michael Andrew "Mike" Bare (born March 1983) is an American policy analyst and Democratic politician from Verona, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 80th Assembly district since 2023. He previously served as a member of the Dane County board of supervisors and, earlier in his career, served as a legislative aide to United States senator Russ Feingold.
